description: Photo to video: turn a single listing photo into a short cinematic real estate video with a professional camera move (zoom, orbit, fly-through, crane up…). No second frame needed. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

direction.description: The direction the camera travels, for the moves that have one (orbit, pan, drone-orbit). 'left-to-right' sends the camera rightward, 'right-to-left' leftward. Ignored by every other move; omit to use the move's own default.

durationSeconds.description: Clip length in seconds. Leave out for the default 5 s; 10 s costs about twice as much — use it only when the user asks for a longer video.

imageUrl.description: Public https URL of the source photo, or a data: URI. Either imageUrl or r2Path is required.

r2Path.description: Storage path of a photo already in the user's Pixly library (from list_library, or returned by an upload ticket) — the alternative to imageUrl.

name: cinematic_motion

quote.description: Present when status is "awaiting_confirmation": nothing ran and nothing was charged yet — the price and settings the user is asked to confirm

resultPaths.description: Storage path of each result — pass one as r2Path (or beforeR2Path, a photos[] item) to run another tool on this result

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running

title: Cinematic Motion
